NOT ALL WHO WANDER ARE LOST

Field notes.

01 / Find your footing

Move with A/D or arrows. Press Space twice for a double jump. On your phone, use the buttons below the forest.

02 / Take what you need

Stand beside trees, rocks, berries, or glowing crystals and hold Action (E). Trees give wood, rocks give stone. Supplies return each morning.

03 / Make camp

The fire is your home. Return to it and open Build (B). Build a shelter, sharpen your axe, and refuel the fire with wood. A lit fire hurts nearby shadows; a shelter heals you near camp.

04 / See another sunrise

You get 90 seconds of daylight and 45 seconds of night. Fight shadows with Action. Eat berries (Q) to heal. Falling costs 20 health and returns you to camp. Survive three nights to win.

Progress saves in this browser. Switching tabs pauses the adventure.
Made for a little escape. Explore with curiosity. Return with firewood.
